title: Leafify
description: Leafifiy enhances Minecraft’s leaves with updated models and textures, giving trees a more natural and improved look while keeping the original game feel.
body: Leafifiy is a Minecraft texture pack that focuses on improving the look of leaves. It changes the leaf blocks with a cleaner and more detailed model and texture, making trees look more natural and visually pleasing. The style stays close to vanilla Minecraft, but with a fresher and more realistic touch to the foliage.
